``extra="forbid"`` keeps the schema closed, so a caller cannot smuggle
fields (settings, a snapshot, a provider URL) into the request. The length
bound stops an unbounded prompt from reaching the model.

Workflow transition for one playbook.

``extra="forbid"`` keeps a client from smuggling analytical fields through
this endpoint: a status change must never be able to touch the model.

Alternative parameters for one comparison.

``overrides`` is deliberately narrow: only model parameters are accepted, so
a scenario cannot reach balances, prices, statuses or raw transactions.

get.description:
Return the customer's playbooks with their workflow status attached.

A recommendation without a stored row is reported as ``new``, so the list
is always complete and an untouched playbook needs no write.
get.summary: Рекомендации по удержанию и их статусы

patch.description:
Move one playbook to a new status.

Only the addressed ``(customer, code)`` pair changes. The recommendation must
exist in the current calculation, so a stale or invented code is rejected
rather than silently stored.

post.summary: Безопасная тестовая отправка на контролируемый адрес

get.description:
Export the filtered, sorted selection with its calculation metadata.

Rows are read in pages and written to the response as they arrive, so peak
memory stays proportional to one page rather than to the whole selection.
Buffering every row first was measured at 50 000 customers to hold ~3.5 GiB
resident and take 40 s; streaming keeps the working set bounded.

The row set and order come from the same storage query the list endpoint
uses, so the file matches what the analyst sees on screen.
get.summary: Экспорт текущей выборки клиентов в CSV

post.description:
Answer a portfolio question from the published aggregates.

Read-only: the model receives only aggregated figures from the published
calculation and the data-quality summary. Customer e-mails, individual
records, the raw snapshot, the renewal list and every credential are never
sent. The model narrates; it never computes or writes.

Failure is honest: a disabled, unreachable or malformed provider returns
**503**, and nothing is replaced by a canned answer. A response that
invents a number is rejected as ungrounded.
post.summary: Ответ на вопрос по агрегатам расчёта с помощью локальной модели

get.description:
Customers with independent risk, exposure, urgency and quality signals.

The four measurements stay separate; the returned categories organise work
and carry no probability.  Sorting is deterministic: a stable tie-breaker on
customer id keeps the order reproducible.
Audit the raw snapshot. Never modifies a record.

post.description:
Evaluate alternative parameters against the published configuration.

Nothing is persisted: the working settings, the stored snapshot and the
published generation are untouched.  Applying a scenario to the live
configuration remains an explicit action on ``PATCH /model/settings``.
post.summary: Сравнить сценарий параметров с текущими настройками

get.description:
Operator view: feature state and (with the bot on) live Bot API identity.

Never returns the bot token or the webhook secret — only whether they are
set. ``getMe``/``getWebhookInfo`` are read only when the bot is enabled, so
the endpoint adds no outbound call on a disabled deployment.

post.description:
Register the public HTTPS webhook URL with Telegram.

Explicit, not automatic: re-registering on every restart races with other
instances and can drop pending updates. Telegram requires a public HTTPS URL;
a non-HTTPS URL is refused with a clear reason instead of an opaque API error.
